autoExpandParent.zh-CN: expandedKeys 变化时是否自动展开其中节点的父节点；挂载时总会展开。开启后，展开受控时要先收起所有已展开的子节点才能收起父节点。
autoExpandParent.en-US: Whether the parents of the nodes in expandedKeys expand automatically when expandedKeys changes; they always do on mount. When on, a controlled tree collapses a parent only after its expanded children are collapsed.

autoExpandWhenDragEnter.zh-CN: 拖拽到收起的节点上时是否自动展开该节点。
autoExpandWhenDragEnter.en-US: Whether dragging over a collapsed node expands it.

autoMergeValue.zh-CN: 父节点被选中时，值不再包含它的子孙节点；leafOnly 为 false 时生效。
autoMergeValue.en-US: When a parent is selected the value leaves out its descendants; applies when leafOnly is false.

blockNode.zh-CN: 节点显示为整行，悬浮和选中高亮整行；关闭时只高亮节点的 label。
blockNode.en-US: Shows each node as a whole row, highlighting the row on hover and selection; when off only the label is highlighted.

checkRelation.zh-CN: 多选时节点之间选中状态的关系：related 为父子联动，unRelated 为互不影响。
checkRelation.en-US: How the checked states of nodes relate in a multiple tree: related links parents and children, unRelated keeps them independent.

directory.zh-CN: 目录树模式，自带目录图标，可用 icon snippet 覆盖。
directory.en-US: Directory mode with built-in folder icons, which the icon snippet can replace.

disableStrictly.zh-CN: 严格禁用：禁用的节点不能通过父级或子级的选中关系改变状态。
disableStrictly.en-US: Strict disabling: a disabled node cannot change state through the selection of its parent or children.

disabled.zh-CN: 禁用整棵树。节点数据中的 disabled: false 不会解除禁用。
disabled.en-US: Disables the whole tree. A node with disabled: false does not lift it.

draggable.zh-CN: 是否允许拖拽节点，配合 onDrop 使用。不能与 virtualize 同时使用。
draggable.en-US: Whether nodes can be dragged, used together with onDrop. It cannot be combined with virtualize.

emptyContent.zh-CN: 没有节点，或开启 showFilteredOnly 后搜索无结果时的内容。
emptyContent.en-US: Content shown when there are no nodes, or when the search finds none with showFilteredOnly on.

expandAction.zh-CN: 展开逻辑：false 仅点击展开箭头时展开，click 单击节点展开，doubleClick 双击节点展开。键盘不触发该逻辑。
expandAction.en-US: How a node expands: false only through the arrow, click on a click, doubleClick on a double click. The keyboard does not use it.

expandAll.zh-CN: 展开所有节点，数据变化后仍然生效。
expandAll.en-US: Expands every node, and keeps doing so when the data changes.

expandIcon.zh-CN: 自定义展开图标，参数为 `{ onClick, class, expanded }`；需要把 `class` 与 `onclick` 放在渲染的元素上。
expandIcon.en-US: The expand icon, with `{ onClick, class, expanded }` as its argument; put `class` and `onclick` on the element it renders.

expandedKeys.zh-CN: 展开的节点，可用 `bind:expandedKeys` 绑定；不绑定时，传入的值只作为初始展开的节点，显示其直接子级。`bind:expandedKeys={get, set}` 使展开状态完全受控。
expandedKeys.en-US: Expanded nodes, bindable with `bind:expandedKeys`. Unbound, the given value is only the initially expanded nodes, showing their direct children. `bind:expandedKeys={get, set}` makes expansion fully controlled.

defaultExpandAll.zh-CN: 初始化时展开所有节点。之后 treeData 或 treeDataSimpleJson 的变化不再影响展开状态，需要时使用 expandAll。
defaultExpandAll.en-US: Expands every node on mount. Later changes of treeData or treeDataSimpleJson do not affect it; use expandAll for that.

filterTreeNode.zh-CN: 是否开启搜索。传 true 时按 treeNodeFilterProp 匹配；传函数时自定义匹配，data 为当前节点数据。
filterTreeNode.en-US: Whether search is on. true matches by treeNodeFilterProp; a function customizes the match, with data as the node.

fullLabel.zh-CN: 接管整行的内容，参数含 `class`、`data`、`level`、`expandIcon`、`checkStatus`、`expandStatus`、`filtered`、`searchWord` 和 `onClick`、`onCheck`、`onExpand`、`onContextmenu`、`onDblclick`。带 id、role 与状态的行元素由 Tree 提供，snippet 只写行内内容；虚拟化时定位样式也在行元素上。
fullLabel.en-US: Content of the whole row. Its argument holds `class`, `data`, `level`, `expandIcon`, `checkStatus`, `expandStatus`, `filtered`, `searchWord` and `onClick`, `onCheck`, `onExpand`, `onContextmenu`, `onDblclick`. Tree provides the row element carrying the id, role and state, and virtualized positioning; the snippet holds only what is inside.

hideDraggingNode.zh-CN: 拖拽时隐藏被拖拽节点的拖拽图像。
hideDraggingNode.en-US: Hides the drag image of the node being dragged.

icon.zh-CN: 自定义节点图标，参数含 `item`、`level`、`expanded`、`isLeaf`、`loading`、`selected`、`checked`、`halfChecked`，可按节点返回不同内容；输出为空时保留目录模式的内置图标。
icon.en-US: A node's icon. Its argument holds `item`, `level`, `expanded`, `isLeaf`, `loading`, `selected`, `checked` and `halfChecked`, so it can differ by node; empty output keeps the directory icon.

keyMaps.zh-CN: 自定义节点中 key、label、value 的字段名。映射了 label 且开启搜索时，需把 treeNodeFilterProp 设为 treeData 的键之一，或自定义 filterTreeNode。
keyMaps.en-US: Custom field names for key, label and value in a node. When label is mapped and search is on, set treeNodeFilterProp to one of the keys in treeData or provide filterTreeNode.

label.zh-CN: 自定义节点的 label 内容，参数为 `{ item, label, searchWord }`。开启搜索时仍按 treeData 中的 label 文本匹配。
label.en-US: Content of a node's label, with `{ item, label, searchWord }` as its argument. Search still matches the label text in treeData.

labelEllipsis.zh-CN: label 超出时是否省略；虚拟化时默认开启。
labelEllipsis.en-US: Whether an overflowing label is truncated; on by default for a virtualized tree.

leafOnly.zh-CN: 多选时，值和 onChange 的载荷只包含叶子节点。
leafOnly.en-US: In a multiple tree, the value and the payload of onChange hold leaf nodes only.

loadData.zh-CN: 异步加载子节点，返回 Promise。需要在数据中用 isLeaf 标明叶子节点；设置后未标明 isLeaf 的节点显示展开箭头。
loadData.en-US: Loads the children of a node and returns a Promise. Mark leaves with isLeaf in the data; a node without isLeaf shows the expand arrow while this is set.

loadedKeys.zh-CN: 已加载的节点，配合 loadData 使用，可用 `bind:loadedKeys` 绑定。
loadedKeys.en-US: Nodes already loaded, used with loadData and bindable with `bind:loadedKeys`.

motion.zh-CN: 是否开启展开收起的动画；虚拟化时动画关闭。
motion.en-US: Whether expanding and collapsing are animated; animation is off for a virtualized tree.

multiple.zh-CN: 是否多选。多选时所有子项都被选择会自动勾选其父项。
multiple.en-US: Whether several nodes can be selected. A parent is checked automatically once all its children are.

onChange.zh-CN: 选中状态变化时触发，参数为当前的值。
onChange.en-US: Called when the selection changes, with the current value.

onChangeWithObject.zh-CN: 设为 true 时，onChange 的参数由 value 变为包含 value、label 及其他属性的节点对象；受控时 value 也要传对象，且必须含 value。
onChangeWithObject.en-US: When true the argument of onChange is the node object with value, label and other fields instead of the value; a controlled value must then be objects with a value.

onContextMenu.zh-CN: 在节点上点击右键时触发，参数为事件与节点数据。
onContextMenu.en-US: Called on a right click on a node, with the event and the node data.

onDoubleClick.zh-CN: 双击节点时触发，参数为事件与节点数据。
onDoubleClick.en-US: Called on a double click on a node, with the event and the node data.

onDragEnter.zh-CN: 拖拽进入节点时触发；进入收起的节点使其展开时，参数含 expandedKeys。
onDragEnter.en-US: Called when a drag enters a node; the argument holds expandedKeys when that expanded a collapsed node.

onDragLeave.en-US: Called when a drag leaves a node.

onDragOver.en-US: Called while a drag is over a node.

onDragStart.en-US: Called when a node starts to be dragged.

onDrop.zh-CN: 节点被放下时触发，参数含 node、dragNode、dragNodesKeys、dropPosition、dropToGap。
onDrop.en-US: Called when a node is dropped; the argument holds node, dragNode, dragNodesKeys, dropPosition and dropToGap.

onExpand.zh-CN: 展开或收起节点时触发，参数为展开的节点 key 数组和含 expanded 与 node 的信息。
onExpand.en-US: Called when a node expands or collapses, with the array of expanded keys and an info object holding expanded and node.

onLoad.zh-CN: 节点加载完毕时触发，参数为已加载节点的集合和刚加载的节点。
onLoad.en-US: Called when a node has loaded, with the set of loaded nodes and the node just loaded.

onSearch.zh-CN: 搜索框的值变化时触发；filteredExpandedKeys 是因搜索或 value 而展开的节点，可在展开受控时用来展开搜索结果。
onSearch.en-US: Called when the search input changes; filteredExpandedKeys are the nodes expanded by the search or by value, which controlled expansion can use to show the results.

onSelect.zh-CN: 节点被选中或取消选中时触发，参数为该节点的 key、是否选中和节点数据。
onSelect.en-US: Called when a node is selected or deselected, with its key, whether it is selected and its data.

renderDraggingNode.zh-CN: 拖拽时浏览器显示的元素，参数为节点元素 nodeInstance 与节点数据 node；snippet 在 dragstart 时渲染到游离的容器中作为拖拽图像，只能读到应用级的 context。
renderDraggingNode.en-US: The element the browser shows while a node is dragged, with the node element nodeInstance and the node data node as arguments; on dragstart the snippet is rendered into a detached container and used as the drag image, so only app-level context reaches it.

search.zh-CN: 替换搜索框，参数含 `class`、`value`、`placeholder`、`showClear` 与 `onChange`；传 false 隐藏搜索框，filterTreeNode 仍然过滤。
search.en-US: Replaces the search box, with `class`, `value`, `placeholder`, `showClear` and `onChange` as its argument; false hides the box while filterTreeNode still filters.

searchClassName.en-US: Class of the search box container.

searchStyle.zh-CN: 搜索框容器的样式字符串。
searchStyle.en-US: Style string of the search box container.

showClear.zh-CN: 搜索框是否显示清除按钮。
showClear.en-US: Whether the search box shows a clear button.

showFilteredOnly.zh-CN: 搜索时只展示过滤后的结果。
showFilteredOnly.en-US: Shows only the filtered nodes while searching.

showLine.zh-CN: 显示节点之间的连接线。

treeData.zh-CN: 节点数据，key 在整棵树内唯一。只有传入新数组才会更新，原地修改数组或节点不会生效。节点的图标由 icon snippet 绘制，label 为字符串或数字。
treeData.en-US: Node data; keys are unique across the tree. Only a new array updates the tree, changes made in place are not seen. A node's icon is drawn by the icon snippet, and its label is a string or number.

treeDataSimpleJson.zh-CN: 简单 JSON 形式的节点数据，返回值为包含选中节点的 JSON 数据。
treeDataSimpleJson.en-US: Node data as a plain JSON object; the value is a JSON object holding the selected nodes.

treeNodeFilterProp.zh-CN: 搜索时用于匹配输入的节点属性，默认 label。
treeNodeFilterProp.en-US: The node field matched against the search input, label by default.

value.zh-CN: 当前选中的节点的 value（没有 value 时为 key），可用 `bind:value` 绑定；多选时为数组。不绑定时，传入的值只作为初始选中项；`bind:value={get, set}` 使其完全受控。
value.en-US: Value of the selected node (its key when it has no value), bindable with `bind:value`; an array when multiple. Unbound, the given value is only the initial selection; `bind:value={get, set}` makes it fully controlled.

virtualize.zh-CN: 列表虚拟化，用于大量节点：height、width、itemSize（必传）。开启后动画关闭。
virtualize.en-US: List virtualization for many nodes: height, width and itemSize (required). Animation is off once enabled.

scrollTo.zh-CN: 在虚拟化的 Tree 中，把指定的已展开节点滚动到视图内；align 默认 center。
scrollTo.en-US: In a virtualized tree, scrolls an expanded node into view; align is center by default.

search.zh-CN: 手动触发搜索，效果同在搜索框中输入；需要同时设置 filterTreeNode。
search.en-US: Searches as if the value were typed into the search box; filterTreeNode must be set.
